scholarships.title: Qatar University International Students Scholarship
scholarships.official_source: Qatar University, Office of the Vice President for Student Affairs — Scholarships Section

existing.description: Qatar University offers an International Students Scholarship to international students who apply to its undergraduate programmes, selected on a competitive basis. Applicants must hold a high school certificate or equivalent with a minimum average of 95% and receive final acceptance from the university. The award covers full tuition and textbook fees, pays a monthly salary of 500 QAR, and includes student housing with campus transport, an annual round-trip air fare ticket and a residence permit under Qatar University sponsorship. Transfer students, visiting students, non-degree applicants and applicants seeking a second bachelor's degree are not eligible.
eligibility: International student applying to an undergraduate programme at Qatar University
High school certificate or equivalent with a minimum average of 95%
Meet the admission requirements of the college applied to
Not a transfer student, visiting student, non-degree applicant or applicant seeking a second bachelor's degree
Not in receipt of another sponsorship or scholarship at the same time
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to international (non-Qatari) applicants to undergraduate programmes at Qatar University. Applicants need a high school certificate or equivalent with a minimum average of 95%, must receive final acceptance from Qatar University, must meet the admission requirements of the college applied to, and cannot hold this scholarship alongside another sponsorship or scholarship.
benefits: Student housing, two students per room, including transportation to and from campus
Annual round trip air fare ticket
Residence permit sponsored by Qatar University
coverage: Student housing (two students per room) with transport to and from campus
Residence permit under Qatar University sponsorship
requirements: Continuous registration in Fall and Spring until graduation
Minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 out of 4.0 to maintain the award
Completion of a minimum of 12 credit hours per semester
documents: Documents required for admission to Qatar University
No additional documents are required for this scholarship beyond the admission documents
existing.english_requirement: The university requires proof of English proficiency for admission; the scholarship committee may additionally consider IELTS or TOEFL scores when ranking applicants, but no published minimum scholarship-specific score was found on the official pages read.
application_method: Apply through the Qatar University online admission application in the 'Scholarship Application' section during the announced application period
Submit the original high school transcript and required admission documents to the Admissions Department, Qatar University, P.O. Box 2713, Doha, Qatar
existing.selection_notes: Applicants are selected on a competitive basis and evaluated after the scholarship application deadline. The scholarship committee may consider standard test scores in English (IELTS or TOEFL) and in mathematics (SAT, ACT or the QU Math Placer), or other test scores it selects. Nominees receive an initial conditional acceptance letter, after which Qatar University applies for the student visa.
existing.notes: The scholarship must be used from the semester in which it is awarded; the start may be postponed by one semester with scholarship committee approval. If the recipient does not pass the first semester, the scholarship is cancelled. This record covers the International Students Scholarship only; Qatar University separately runs a Talent Scholarship and GCC States Scholarships with different eligibility rules.
existing.duration: Full-time undergraduate degree at Qatar University
existing.application_period: Scholarship applications are submitted through the Qatar University online admission application during the announced annual period, which the official Scholarship Timeline page lists as 1 March to 25 March.
existing.deadline_display: Online scholarship applications run 1–25 March each year (2026 cycle: 1 March – 25 March 2026)
